usage.add:
oid4vc-wallet credential add --format FORMAT --issuer URL
      (--document TEXT | --document-file PATH)
      Seal a credential. --document-file - reads stdin.
      The key is created in GNOME Keyring the first time, or in KWallet when that service is not available.
usage.crypto:
Credentials are sealed with AES-256-GCM. The 256-bit key is stored in
GNOME Keyring when the Secret Service is available, and in KWallet otherwise.
KeePassXC is used when it provides the Secret Service. The key is not stored
in the credential files.
usage.desktop: The desktop starts the wallet with the URI as its argument. Until then:
usage.footer:
iya-sts hands an offer to openid-credential-offer://, a presentation request
to openid4vp://, and an ID Token request to siopv2://. This build parses and
stores those invocations, and it stores credentials. It does not redeem an
offer or send a presentation yet.
usage.handle:
oid4vc-wallet <uri>
  oid4vc-wallet handle <uri>
      Parse an invocation, print it, and store it in the inbox.
      --json prints one JSON object. --no-save does not write the inbox.
usage.install:
oid4vc-wallet install [--user | --system] [--haip]
      Copy this binary and register it for
      openid-credential-offer://, siopv2:// and openid4vp://.
      --user is the default and writes under your home directory.
      --system writes /usr/share/applications and /etc/xdg/mimeapps.list.
      --haip also registers haip-vci:// and haip-vp://.
usage.intro:
A Linux wallet for OpenID4VCI credential offers and OpenID4VP / SIOPv2
presentation requests. Protocol messages are implemented in this program.
It does not use an OpenID library.
usage.language:
oid4vc-wallet language
      List the languages this wallet offers and mark the one in use.

  oid4vc-wallet language set TAG
      Save TAG for later runs. TAG is one the wallet offers, for example fr-FR.
      --lang TAG uses that language for this run only.

  oid4vc-wallet language clear
      Forget the saved language and follow the language of this session.
usage.list:
oid4vc-wallet credentials
  oid4vc-wallet credential list
  oid4vc-wallet credential show ID
  oid4vc-wallet credential delete ID
      List, open, or remove stored credentials. --json prints JSON.
      Deleting a credential leaves the AES-256 key in GNOME Keyring or KWallet.
usage.title: OID4VC Wallet
usage.uninstall:
oid4vc-wallet uninstall [--user | --system]
      Remove that registration and the copied binary.
